title: Open up the doors of Heaven
lyrics: Verse 1:
Open up the doors of Heaven
We're here to meet with You oh Lord
In this song God we ask
That you'd set Your gaze
Keep the doors of Heaven opened
Verse 2:
We are asking for Your presence
Lord we are waiting for You here
This our prayer, our desire
As a fragrant offering
Give us in return Your presence
Chorus 1:
We ask for You to come
Lord come and dwell among us
Receive all of the glory
As we give You all our praise
Chorus 2:
The name of Jesus Christ
The only name that saves us
Be praised above all others
As we lift Your name on high
